refnamediv.refpurpose: Returns the stored errors of the most recent stream operation

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
arraystream_last_errors
Returns the errors that were stored by the most recent stream operation that stored any. Which errors an operation stores is controlled by the error_store and error_mode stream context options. With the default options no errors are stored.
The stored errors are replaced when a later operation stores errors. They are kept when a later operation succeeds or does not store its errors, and can be discarded with stream_clear_errors.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a list of StreamError objects in the order in which the errors were reported, or an empty array if no errors are stored.
